long_biography.plain_text:
Trained as a pharmacist at the University of Texas, Lester built a career around scaling specialist healthcare services. He founded Radiant Research, which conducted clinical trials for drug developers, and later Accelecare Wound Centers. Both businesses expanded through multi-site operations and acquisitions before strategic sales, establishing the operating model he brought to later ventures.

In 2017, Lester co-founded LifeStance Health and served as chief executive and chairman as it assembled a national outpatient mental-health platform and completed its public listing. He retired from those roles in 2022. He later co-founded Nira Medical, where he serves as executive chairman, developing a network of independent neurology practices focused on outpatient care.
